purpose: Golden of the v2 model for the parity tests of the prompt (ids), of the option keys (ids) and of the engine (scores).
inputs: Written by the archai-jev authors: states, instructions and options of every shape the Decision Index format allows (string, dict, list, empty and unicode states; structured instructions and descriptions; 2-6 options; keys of 1-4 tokens).
outputs: Reference engine of the Decision Index kit: prompt ids, key token ids, option scores (sum of the full-vocabulary log-probabilities of the key tokens) and probabilities.
regenerate: spec/playground/s10-quantization/t9/make_v2_golden.py (local, not versioned): <S1 venv> make_v2_golden.py MERGED_DIR OUT_DIR
